offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace that connects travelers with hosts offering homes, rooms and experiences. It earns booking fees from guests and hosts, delivered through websites and mobile apps.

primary_services.value: short-term home rentals; hotel booking; experiences and tours; business travel management

customer_segment.value: B2C: travelers booking stays and experiences, and individuals hosting homes; B2B: companies booking business travel through Airbnb for Work

end_markets.value: travel and tourism; hospitality; real estate

revenue_model.value: service fees: guest and host fees charged on each booking

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: marketplace connecting hosts with guests, sold to travelers and hosts; service provider: host support, cleaning and experiences booked through the platform

geography_served.value: global: worldwide, with listings in many countries and regions

specialization.value: related lines: short-term home rentals, experiences, and business travel

distribution_channels.value: online: company website and mobile apps for guests and hosts; partners / resellers: travel partners and integrations with other booking sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local short-term rental rules, occupancy taxes, and data privacy laws
